textbookText: However, considering the case of formation of methane molecules, the number of half-filled atomic orbitals is not equal to the number of bonds formed. Carbon has only two half-filled p- orbitals but in CH4 carbon forms four bonds with four hydrogen atoms. It means formation of methane does not involve the overlapping of pure p- orbitals of carbon.
One of the electrons from 2s- orbital is excited to higher (2p) orbital and forms four halffilled orbitals.

But these pure orbitals are not used for bonding, instead these orbitals combine to form four new and equivalent orbitals called hybrid orbitals. The process of formation of hybrid orbitals from pure atomic orbitals is called hybridization. Since one s- orbital mix with three porbitals, the new orbitals formed are called sp3 hybrid orbitals and the phenomenon is called sp3 hybridization.

Excited state electronic configuration of carbon sp3 hybridized configuration of carbon These four sp3 hybrid orbitals overlap with four s – orbitals of hydrogen atom to form tetrahedral methane molecules.

Hybridized orbitals formed have certain characteristics, they are: a. The number of hybrid orbitals formed always equals the number of atomic orbitals used. b. A set of hybrid orbitals always have definite directional characteristics. c. Hybrid orbitals are equivalent in energy also called degenerate hybrid orbitals.

Types of hybridizations involving s and p orbitals a. sp hybridization When one s- orbital mixes with one p-orbital to form two identical hybrid orbitals, it is called sp hybridization or linear or diagonal hybridization. The resulting two sp hybrid orbitals remain in opposite directions in a straight line at an angle of 1800 angle making a linear shape. sp hybridization forms a sigma bond but leaves the space for the creation of pi bonds. Examples BeCl2, CO2, C2H2, etc. CHEMISTRY, GRADE 11 | 177

These sp hybridized orbitals overlap with the two p-orbitals of chlorine atoms to form a linear BeCl2 molecule.

In the case of ethyne, among the four half-filled atomic orbitals of excited carbon atom, only one is used to mix with s -orbital forming two sp - hybrid orbitals and the remaining two unhybridized p- orbitals overlap laterally forming two pi bonds.

b. Sp2 hybridization When one s- orbital mixes with 2 p-orbitals forming 3 new hybrid orbitals, it is called sp2 hybridization. These 3 sp2 hybrid orbitals lie in the same plane and directed at 1200 angles to each other making a trigonal planar shape. BF3, AlCl3, C2H4, benzene, etc.
In the formation of BCl3, the three sp2 hybrid orbitals of boron overlap with the three pure porbitals of chlorine to form three sigma bonds which are at 1200 forming trigonal planar geometry.

In case of ethene among the three p- orbitals of excited carbon atoms, only two are used to form sp2 hybrid orbitals. The unhybridized p orbital is perpendicular to the plane of the sp2 hybrid orbitals. Three sp2 hybrid orbitals overlap with each other or with the s- orbital of the hydrogen atom and form three sigma bonds. c. sp3 hybridization When one s-orbital combines with three p-orbitals to form four hybrid orbitals, it is called sp3 hybridization. These four sp3 hybrid orbitals point in tetrahedral directions with bond angle 109.50 . Examples include H2O.NH3, CH4, methyl radical, etc.
CHEMISTRY, GRADE 11 | 180
Formation of sp3 hybridization in the carbon atom in CH4 is discussed earlier. These four hybrid orbitals overlap with the s- orbitals of four hydrogen atoms to form tetrahedral molecules of methane.
CHEMISTRY, GRADE 11 | 181

Do you know? Size of hybridized orbitals increases in the order sp<sp2<sp3 Percentage of s- character increases in the order sp > sp2 > sp3 In the case of water, among the four hybrid orbitals of oxygen atoms, two are fulfilled and two are half filled. Only half filled hybrid orbitals are used to overlap with s-orbitals of hydrogen atoms. The unused full filled hybrid orbitals will remain as lone pair. Because of these lone pair lone pair repulsion, the shape of H2O molecule becomes bent instead of tetrahedral as expected from sp3 hybridization.
